title: Cloud Logging: log sinks, filters, retention and export

videos.script: Your program prints a line. On Cloud Run, that line goes to Cloud Logging, with nothing installed. {{line}} What becomes of it depends on its shape. One JSON object per line becomes a structured entry. Anything else is just text. {{shape}} Here is the mistake that hides. A line that says level equals error has no severity at all. Every query for errors walks right past it. {{severity}} Then the router. Every entry passes through it, and sinks decide where it is kept, and for how long. {{router}} Keeping logs is paid by the gigabyte. Dropping the noise is free. {{cost}}
